newsitem.title: USA: Venezuelan Feb inflation expected near 2 pct - Matos.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan Feb inflation expected near 2 pct - Matos.

text.p: Venezuela's rate of inflation for February is expected to come in close to 2.0 percent, down from 2.6 percent in January, said Venezuelan Finance Minister Luis Raul Matos Azocar.
"I expect some good news in February. I think we are going to be very close to two (percentage) points inflation," Matos told Reuters Financial Television in an interview.
The Venezuelan Finance Minister said that a key element in keeping inflation down is to implement structural reforms.

"The most important point is that we are convinced and I think the IMF (International Monetary Fund) team is also convinced that the only way to guarantee that we defeat inflation is make structural reforms," Matos said.
The Venezuelan Finance minister expects the country will meet its inflation target of 30 percent this year.

"We keep the target of 30 percent, but if we manage the exchange rate and are able to put into the market a very aggressive monetary policy, and also with fiscal discipline, I think we can meet the target and the indicators in February will say whether we are on the right track or not," he said.
